activity_b.text: Good morning, please take a seat.
I’m Mr. Rahuman, the mechanical workshop training supervisor.
How are you feeling today?
Good morning, sir. I’m doing fine, thank you.
I’m a bit nervous, but I’m ready to do my best.
That’s perfectly alright.
This is just a friendly interview.
So, Faaris, I see that you completed school last year.
Could you tell me a little about your background?
Yes, sir. I completed my A/Ls in August.
During my final year, I worked part-time in a small mechanical workshop in Puttalam.
I don’t have much experience yet, but I can manage basic workshop tasks confidently.
Good.
What kind of work did you support in the workshop?
I assisted the senior technician with dismantling machine parts, lubricating bearings, and cleaning gear assemblies.
I also helped operate the bench grinder and sometimes checked alignment on the lathe machine.
When the workshop became busy, I arranged the tool racks and checked torque wrenches for the team.
I wasn’t responsible for complex machining, but I always supported the team whenever they needed help.
Excellent.
What skills do you think you can bring to our programme?
I can measure components accurately with vernier calipers, sir.
I know how to identify worn-out parts, and I recently started learning how to use the hydraulic press.
I also learnt how to stay calm when the workload becomes heavy.
I might need some guidance with advanced lathe operations and machine calibration, but I’m going to improve quickly.
That’s a positive attitude.
How comfortable are you with basic maintenance and workshop safety?
I’m not fully confident yet, but I can already handle simple maintenance routines and follow standard safety procedures.
I might take more time with precision machining and complex repairs.
That’s understandable.
What are your plans for the next few years?
I’m going to complete this training programme and then apply for an apprenticeship.
I might also follow short mechanical safety courses to strengthen my technical skills.
Very good.
Thank you, Faaris. We’ll contact you soon.
Thank you very much, sir. I appreciate the opportunity.
